summary:
Project Helios-I , A futuristic robotic space satellite as a large Structure floating in space.
It is an spacemission of launching a giant robotic satellite in space. It is very important bcz it will develop a base for development of modern world or futuristic technology. It will develop a futuristic future of space exploration. HELIOS spacecraft is made of solar panels in a circular way at top, core system , signal receiver and sender system ,energy transmitter , energy storage with an AI controlled control system .
details:
PROJECT HELIOS-I , a giant modern futuristic robotic spacecraft floating in be and absorbing solar energy through its attached solar power and storing in energy storage . The signal will be sender on earth about the energy storage . When the signal will be received on earth by humans . An manmade small energy transmitter satellite will go and transport energy to earth or a large energy receiving station should be created on earth . All the things working or functioning in spacecraft HELIOS are controlled by AI controllers presented in spacecraft at core controller system .The solar energy sended on earth can be converted in different form of energies and can be used in development of modern human civilization. It will finish the most of the energy problems on earth .It will create a base for the modern future generation and developed spacecraft idea for future exploration .The energy can be replaced as fuel for satellites and rockets as well as some vehicles also . Also at the time of cloudy weather and at night , the spacecraft helios will send solar energy to our earth. That will solve our most of energy problem.

It will create a positive and big impact on our future human civilization space exploration projects and technology development.

The tools used to crate the project demo and project ;

Capcut : For video editing and generating .

HEYGEN : For AI voiceover .

Chat gpt and Google Gemini : For an organised projects, as an AI assistant, Data viewer , Websites finder , Research and preparing files.

It is my own creative project bcz it is my own imagination . It can be considered creative bcz of it's unique design .

The problem factors I considered and discussed with my AI assistant :

*Energy problem on earth.

*Fuel problem in spacecraft for rotating in orbit or for a long distance travel.

* Blockage of energy on earth due to bad weather and nights.

The solution factors that I consider :

*Solar power management .

*Using solar panel and fuel generator from solar energy on satellites .

Hence , Project HELIOS-I is an futuristic modern robotic spacecraft which can play a important role in human civilization development.
